curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When an officer crosses into the criminal underworld, how far outside the law will an investigator go to expose his own colleague?
curatedMovie.description: In Takeshi Kitano's 1989 crime thriller, an unyielding detective discards all ethical limits while digging into a fellow officer's dangerous ties to drug trafficking and yakuza syndicates.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful Japanese crime thriller driven by steady pacing, grim stakes, and engaged solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Kitano directs a bleak, suspenseful crime drama that trades conventional police procedure for severe tension, moral compromise, and unvarnished action.
